infrastructure_policy: retain_and_review; never retry a scored algorithm or budget failure
cutoff_policy: terminal cutoff; grade preserved artifacts once with frozen verifier; do not continue solving
valid_success: integrity and all frozen A/B/D/P checks; no extra parallelism criterion
train_test_grouping: All views with the same project-original DAG300 source family must share a split.
network_enforcement: Docker Compose network_mode:none on agent and verifier
harbor_dispatcher_network_policy: default public; overridden by task-authored Docker network namespace none
admission: Structure M, five valid trials, 2 or 3 strict successes; inspect failed trials for core-business evidence before admission.
